candidate.text: The `CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.cidrs` field has been deprecated in v1.15 favor of `CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.blocks`. As of v1.15 both fields have the same behavior. The `cidrs` field will be removed in v1.16. Please update your IP pool configurations to use `blocks` instead of `cidrs` before upgrading.

evidence.excerpt:
* The `CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.cidrs` field has been deprecated in v1.15 favor of 
  `CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.blocks`. As of v1.15 both fields have the same behavior. The
  `cidrs` field will be removed in v1.16. Please update your IP pool configurations to use
  `blocks` instead of `cidrs` before upgrading.
